hypothesis: Exact used-byte KV digests localize the first observable P0/D0 state divergence to a model layer; if all KV digests match, the finalized-logit divergence is downstream of retained KV state.

common: P0 and D0 complete inference, transcript capture, provider release, and zero exit
prompt, source, model, token count, KV layer count, per-layer byte geometry, and finalized-logit geometry match
P0 and D0 each reproduce their predecessor selected token and finalized-logit digest
acceptance.layerBoundary: Report the first layer whose key or value used-byte digest differs and retain all later differences without claiming causation.
acceptance.downstreamBoundary: If every KV used-byte digest matches, localize the divergence after retained KV state.
acceptance.invalid: Missing bytes, mismatched geometry, changed predecessor logits, timeout, or nonzero exit rejects the evidence.

creditBoundary.correctProvider: unassigned without an independent operation oracle
creditBoundary.onPass: Freeze one operation-level parity fixture at or before the first observed differing layer.
